note: Returning-officer declarations retained independently of the live candidate feed. STV declarations do not enter the FPTP swing corpus or grading. Turnout_pct here is percentage points, matching contest declarations, not the fractional history contract.

local.aberdeen-city.midstocketrosemount..note: Aberdeen City Council's declaration of results: Jeff Diack (SNP) elected at stage 8 under STV. Electorate 11,768; 3,121 ballot papers received, turnout 26.5%; 33 rejected (30 with a first preference against more than one candidate, 3 unmarked or void), leaving 3,088 first preferences. Quota 1,545. First preferences: Diack (SNP) 861, John (Conservative) 743, Young (Labour) 535, Bird (Scottish Greens) 330, McLeod (Reform UK) 323, Stephen (Lib Dem) 192, Singal (Independent) 67, McLean (Independent) 37. First preferences are not a final-round margin or an FPTP result; this declaration is not forecast-graded.

local.argyll-and-bute.mid-argyll.by.2026.note: Argyll and Bute Council's published result: Andy Buntin (SNP) elected at stage 5 under STV. Electorate 6,113; 1,798 ballot papers received, turnout 29.4%; 18 rejected, leaving 1,780 first preferences. Quota 891. First preferences: Buntin (SNP) 820, MacDonald (Scottish Liberal Democrats) 310, Osborn (Scottish Conservative) 230, McConnell (Reform UK) 151, Love (Restore Britain) 124, Nelson (Independence for Scotland Party) 95, Moncrieff (Independent) 50. The council's own page says 1,798 valid ballot papers; with 18 rejected the first preferences sum to 1,780, which is what the quota of 891 is built on, so 1,798 is ballot papers received. First preferences are not a final-round margin or an FPTP result; this declaration is not forecast-graded.
